perspective:
Jose Castillo’s available information:

- He and Patricia are colleagues at a community bank; he occasionally helps with maintenance and repairs there, and they have a friendly, professional relationship.
- He noticed Patricia seemed more withdrawn than usual during recent shifts. He remembered her as usually vibrant and suspected something might be troubling her.
- He approached her and asked if she was okay. Patricia said it was “nothing really,” just “some personal stuff,” and thanked him for asking.
- He offered to listen if she ever wanted to talk. Patricia said she appreciated that and that it meant a lot.
- Later, during a lunch break, he overheard Patricia on the phone sounding worried about bills and financial commitments.
- He brought up financial planning with her, mentioning he’d been reading about it. Patricia said it could be helpful and that she’d been overwhelmed with her bills.
- He offered to look over budgeting tips together whenever she felt up to it. Patricia thanked him and said she’d take him up on it soon.
- After that conversation, he worried he might have overstepped by bringing up her finances.
- He told Patricia he hoped she didn’t mind, and that he wanted to help, not pry. Patricia said she didn’t think he was prying and was grateful for the offer.
- He told her he respected her privacy and wanted to support her as a friend. Patricia said she really appreciated that.
- He sensed from their last conversation that Patricia appreciated his concern but preferred to handle her issues privately.
- He later asked how she was doing and if she had weekend plans. Patricia said she was fine and was planning a quiet weekend at home; she asked about his weekend.
- He said he planned to catch up on reading and relax, and reminded her she could reach out if she needed anything or wanted to chat. Patricia thanked him and said she’d keep that in mind.
- He has continued to check in with Patricia at work to maintain a supportive presence.
- During one check-in, Patricia said she was busy but handling it, thanked him for checking in, and said it was great to have his support.
- He responded that she could ask for help with anything, even just grabbing a coffee, and said they’re all there to help each other out.
